purpose: Compare unlike alternatives across a domain-neutral, evidence-bearing dimension model without choosing or executing a winner.
invariants: Raw values, units, assumptions, evidence references and confidence are preserved.
Hard-ineligible options remain visible but are marked ineligible and cannot be made eligible by weights or preferences.
Missing data reduces coverage/confidence and is never silently imputed unless the dimension explicitly declares a missing policy.
Weights express comparison emphasis, not authority.
Preferences may tune weights only through allowed advisory preference keys.
Comparison does not rank, recommend, select best action, approve or execute.
Pareto dominance is descriptive, not a recommendation.
company_id must match across comparison request, options and all incorporated constraint/preference context.
